Simultaneously, Russian sovereign wealth funds and private capital are eyeing Indian renewable‑energy projects, offering capital at concessional rates. By navigating these dynamics prudently, India can turn Russia’s billionaire resurgence from a latent threat into a strategic lever, reinforcing its autonomy, sustaining its energy needs, and maintaining a nuanced balance in the evolving great‑power contest.
